name: exact_utf16_order
source: ['\ue000', '\ud800', '\ufffd', '\udc00', '😀', 'é', 'a', ''].sort().map(x => { let r = ''; for (let i=0; i<x.length; i++) r += x.charCodeAt(i) + ','; return r; }).join('|')

name: holes_and_undefined
source: let a = [3, , undefined, 11, , 2]; a.sort(); [a.join('|'), a.length, 3 in a, 4 in a, 5 in a].join(';')

name: toSorted_reads_holes
source: let a = [3, , undefined, 11, , 2]; let b = a.toSorted(); [b.join('|'), a[0], 1 in a, 4 in b, 5 in b].join(';')

name: primitive_prototype_hooks_are_not_called
source: let n=0; Number.prototype.toString = function(){n++;throw 'number';}; Boolean.prototype.toString = function(){n++;throw 'bool';}; BigInt.prototype.toString = function(){n++;throw 'bigint';}; [3, 20, true, false, null, 4n].sort().join('|') + ';' + n

name: object_toString_is_live
source: let count=0; let a={toString(){count++; return '2';}}; let b={toString(){count++; return '10';}}; let r=[a,b].sort(); (r[0]===b) + '|' + (r[1]===a) + '|' + count

name: boxed_primitives_use_hooks
source: let calls=0; let a=new Number(1); a.toString=function(){calls++;return 'z';}; let b=new Number(2); b.toString=function(){calls++;return 'a';}; let r=[a,b].sort(); (r[0]===b) + '|' + calls

name: symbol_error_and_singleton
source: let s=Symbol('k'); let threw=false; try {[0,s].sort();} catch(e){threw=e instanceof TypeError;} threw + '|' + ([s].sort()[0]===s)

name: custom_comparator_is_not_replaced
source: let calls=0; let r=[10,undefined,2,1,undefined].sort((a,b)=>{calls++; if(a===undefined||b===undefined)throw 'undefined'; return b-a;}); r.join('|') + ';' + (calls>0)

name: getters_are_captured_before_writes
source: let trace=''; let a={length:3,get 0(){trace+='a';return 2;},set 0(v){trace+='x'+v;},get 1(){trace+='b';return 10;},set 1(v){trace+='y'+v;},get 2(){trace+='c';return 1;},set 2(v){trace+='z'+v;}}; Array.prototype.sort.call(a); trace

name: coercion_throw_preserves_receiver
source: let count=0; let a={id:1,toString(){count++;throw 'boom';}}; let b={id:2,toString(){count++;throw 'boom';}}; let r=[a,b]; let caught=''; try {r.sort();} catch(e){caught=e;} caught+'|'+r[0].id+'|'+r[1].id+'|'+count
